prompt: Implement a modular Enterprise Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Server in C# with: (1) SSH Transport Layer security handling cryptographic key exchange, (2) Virtual File System (VFS) abstraction mapping user sessions to isolated directory sandboxes, and (3) Audit Logging Subsystem recording file access and transfer metrics.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Transport Score: 0-5 (Evaluates SSH protocol integration and key negotiation)
Module 2 Vfs Score: 0-5 (Evaluates secure path traversal prevention and sandbox isolation)
Module 3 Audit Score: 0-5 (Evaluates structured logging and event tracking)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates secure session handling and error management)
